alphabeta.original_label: Artin–Tits group, pure subgroup and positive lifts
alphabeta.source_excerpt:
Let $(W,S)$ be a Coxeter system with $S=\{s_i:i\in\Gamma_0\}$ finite, and let $\mathcal X^{\mathbb C}$ be its classical complexified hyperplane complement. Choose $Z\in\mathcal X^{\mathbb C}$ and write $\overline Z$ for its orbit in $\mathcal X^{\mathbb C}/W$. The Artin–Tits group is $A=\pi_1(\mathcal X^{\mathbb C}/W,\overline Z)$, the group of based loop-homotopy classes in the quotient. The pure Artin–Tits group is $P=\pi_1(\mathcal X^{\mathbb C},Z)$, identified with its image in $A$ under the covering map. Let $\pi:A\to W$ send a loop class to the unique $w$ for which its lift starting at $Z$ ends at $wZ$.

Fix an isomorphism over $W$ from the presented Artin group to $A$ supplied by the fundamental-group identification. The presented group has generators $a_s$ for $s\in S$ and, for distinct $s,t$ with finite $m(s,t)=\operatorname{ord}(st)$, the relation equating the two alternating words of length $m(s,t)$ beginning with $a_s$ and $a_t$ respectively. Write $\sigma_s\in A$ for the image of $a_s$, and $\sigma_i=\sigma_{s_i}$. For a reduced expression $w=s_1\cdots s_r$, meaning an expression of minimum length among words in $S$ representing $w$, define the positive lift $\sigma_w=\sigma_{s_1}\cdots\sigma_{s_r}$; the empty product is the identity. Thus $w\mapsto\sigma_w$ is a set-theoretic section of $\pi$.

Let $(W,S)$ be a finite-rank Coxeter system indexed by $S=\{s_i:i\in\Gamma_0\}$, let $A$ be its Artin–Tits group, and let $P=\ker(\pi:A\to W)$ be its pure Artin–Tits group. For $J\subseteq\Gamma_0$, let $W_J=\langle s_j:j\in J\rangle$ and $A_J=\langle\sigma_j:j\in J\rangle$ be the standard parabolic subgroups; the brackets denote the subgroups generated by the displayed elements.

For $G=W$ with $G_J=W_J$, or $G=A$ with $G_J=A_J$, define the **normaliser** of $G_J$ in $G$ by $\operatorname{Norm}_G(G_J)=\{g\in G:gG_Jg^{-1}=G_J\}$. Define the normaliser quotient groups $N(W,J)=\operatorname{Norm}_W(W_J)/W_J$ and $N(A,J)=\operatorname{Norm}_A(A_J)/A_J$.

Define $N(P,J)=\{\beta A_J\in N(A,J):P\cap\beta A_J\ne\varnothing\}$. Equivalently, $N(P,J)$ is the image of $P\cap\operatorname{Norm}_A(A_J)$ under the quotient homomorphism $\operatorname{Norm}_A(A_J)\to N(A,J)$.

alphabeta.source_excerpt:
Let $\Gamma$ be a finite-rank spherical Coxeter diagram, meaning that its Coxeter group $W$ is finite, with vertex set $\Gamma_0$. Let $A$ be its Artin–Tits group and fix $J\subseteq\Gamma_0$. For $I\subseteq\Gamma_0$, write $W_I$ for the subgroup generated by the simple reflections indexed by $I$. An **associate** of $J$ is a subset $I$ for which $W_I$ is conjugate to $W_J$ in $W$.

Let $\mathcal R'(J)$ be the ribbon groupoid: its objects are the associates of $J$, and an arrow $I\to K$ is an element $\beta\in A$ with $A_I^+\beta=\beta A_K^+$, tagged with its source and target. Here $A_I^+$ is the submonoid generated by the standard Artin generators indexed by $I$. Composition is multiplication from left to right.

For an associate $I$ and $a\in\Gamma_0\setminus I$, put $T=I\cup\{a\}$. Let $w_T$ be the longest element of $W_T$, let $\iota_T:T\to T$ be the opposition permutation defined by $w_T\alpha_i=-\alpha_{\iota_T(i)}$ on the simple roots, and put $K=T\setminus\{\iota_T(a)\}$. If $\Delta_L$ denotes the positive reduced-word lift in $A$ of the longest element of $W_L$, the elementary ribbon is $\mu_{a,I}=\Delta_I^{-1}\Delta_T$, regarded as an arrow $I\to K$ of $\mathcal R'(J)$.

The **reduced ribbon groupoid** $\mathcal R(J)$ is the subgroupoid of $\mathcal R'(J)$ with all the same objects whose arrows are finite composable products of the arrows $\mu_{a,I}$ and their inverses, including empty products as identities. Equivalently, it is the smallest subgroupoid of $\mathcal R'(J)$ containing every object and every such elementary ribbon arrow.

alphabeta.source_excerpt:
Let $\Gamma$ be a spherical Coxeter diagram, meaning that its Coxeter group $W$ is finite, with vertex set $\Gamma_0$ and associated Artin–Tits group $A$. Let $A^+$ be the submonoid of $A$ generated by the standard Artin generators. For $J\subseteq\Gamma_0$, let $w_J$ be the longest element of the standard parabolic subgroup $W_J$, and let $\Delta_J$ be its positive reduced-word lift in $A$.

Let $I\subseteq\Gamma_0$ and $a\in I^c=\Gamma_0\setminus I$. Write $I+a=I\cup\{a\}$, and let $[I,a]$ be the vertex set of the connected component containing $a$ in the diagram induced on $I+a$. Write $[I,a]-a=[I,a]\setminus\{a\}$. The **positive elementary ribbon element** associated to $(a,I)$ is

$$\mu_{a,I}=\Delta_{[I,a]-a}^{-1}\Delta_{[I,a]}\in A^+.$$

Equivalently, $\mu_{a,I}=\Delta_I^{-1}\Delta_{I+a}$. Inverses and products in these expressions are taken in $A$.
